component.heading_t: Why this is the practical AI play for software teams.

item.text_t: AI-assisted development compresses the tedious parts of software delivery while experienced engineers keep requirements, architecture, security, and maintainability in focus.
AI agents can check user flows repeatedly and patiently, making them ideal for smoke tests, regression passes, and pre-release validation.
AI accelerates the work, but humans own the judgment calls. We keep plans, code, tests, and release decisions inspectable.
